mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.name, g.phone_num, g.description, g.address, g.file, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 1), 0) AS rating, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS review_count FROM GYM g LEFT JOIN REVIEW_GYM r ON g.id = r.gym_id WHERE g.id = #{value} GROUP BY g.id, g.name, g.phone_num, g.description, g.address, g.file

SELECT HOUR(start_time) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS visitCount, 100 AS heightPercent FROM WORKOUT_LOG WHERE gym_id = #{gymId} AND `date` = CURDATE() GROUP BY HOUR(start_time) ORDER BY visitCount DESC LIMIT 1
